mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a pleasant 78 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park with clear skies, though please note an elevated air quality index of 55 today. We are currently in a new moon phase.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous vote, providing a long-term roadmap for housing, transportation, and sustainability. Additionally, residents are encouraged to stay connected with the city by subscribing to the official digital newsletter for updates on local projects.
There is plenty to do this weekend with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard happening today and yoga sessions at Insight Wellness available tomorrow.
In a noteworthy call for service on September 28, officers responded to a collision involving a 16-year-old operating an e-motorcycle recklessly, resulting in multiple citations for the juvenile.
Stop by Culver's of Verona today to enjoy the delicious Caramel Cashew flavor of the day; the store is open and serving until 10 PM.
